thesis: Search can merge histories with identical relevant futures when a sufficient interface composes exactly, but finding economical interfaces is the open research challenge.
role: Chapters 9–13 give the central proposition, algorithms and counterexample mechanisms.

ideas.statement: Execution and verification do not guarantee efficient discovery; account for libraries, representation, preprocessing and checking.
Continuation equivalence is relative to permitted observations, including provenance or effects; similarity on samples is not proof.
If summary updates commute with every admissible operation and preserve final observation, equal summaries support exact continuation by induction.
Layered merging bounds extension evaluations by stages times distinct summaries times branching, with representation, budget and arithmetic costs additional.
Dynamic programming, knowledge compilation, small separators and algebraic structure exploit conditional structure; e-graph equality differs from alternative interpretation.
Backward requirements filter candidates; abstract overlap is not realizability. CEGAR repairs abstractions; CEGIS repairs candidate programs.
Learned interfaces should survive distinguishing continuations and transfer beyond examples, rather than accumulate exceptions; budget-limited failure to refute is not proof.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Sum requires a partial sum, mean also a count, while median generally needs more.
Affine coefficients remain sufficient under affine operations but not squaring.
The x/x rewrite requires nonzero input under suitable semantics.
Continuation equivalence can merge different inputs and histories, beyond ordinary memoization of identical inputs.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Neither a huge number of summaries nor expensive discovery yields economical compression automatically.
Underlying dynamic programming and congruence mathematics is acknowledged prior work.
Misinterpreted text can leave both abstraction and program verification solving the wrong problem.

audit.notes: Read every unit; preserve proposed versus demonstrated status.
